whats_not_detected:
1) Facial recognition or facial identification
2) Gender, race, ethnicity, age or other personal characteristics
3) Identity of drivers, passengers, or pedestrians
4) Personal information unrelated to the vehicle or license plate
acceptable_use_policy: Data is used for law enforcement purposes only. Data is owned by Burbank CA PD and is never sold or provided to unauthorized parties.
prohibited_uses: Immigration enforcement, traffic enforcement, harassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class including race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or other protected status. Personal use.
access_policy: All system access requires a legitimate law enforcement purpose and is logged for auditing and accountability purposes. Access records are retained indefinitely.
hotlist_policy: ALPR alerts are not acted upon automatically. Each alert must be reviewed and verified by a law enforcement employee before any enforcement action is taken.

overview:
Burbank CA PD uses Flock Safety technology to capture objective evidence without compromising on individual privacy. Burbank CA PD utilizes retroactive search to solve crimes after they've occurred. Additionally, Burbank CA PD utilizes real time alerting of hotlist vehicles to capture wanted criminals. In an effort to ensure proper usage and guardrails are in place, they have made the below policies and usage statistics available to the public.
